description: This source file defines the DefaultBlockPoolMonitor class in C#, which implements monitoring for a block pool including memory metrics and counters, primarily used in Orleans streaming.

classes.name: DefaultBlockPoolMonitor
classes.description: Implements IBlockPoolMonitor to monitor and report memory usage of a block pool, providing observable counters for total, available, claimed, released, and allocated memory.

methods.name: DefaultBlockPoolMonitor
methods.description: Constructor initializing memory counters and dimensions based on provided dimensions or dimension object.

methods.name: Report
methods.description: Updates memory metrics with new values for total, available, and claimed memory.

methods.name: TrackMemoryReleased
methods.description: Tracks the amount of memory released, updating internal counter.

methods.name: TrackMemoryAllocated
methods.description: Tracks memory allocation events, updating internal counter.
